title: Meta
description: Meta layer (spec-v1.0: 'Audit and governance metadata'). Auxiliary audit data about the record itself. Meta never carries observation content.

record_id.description: Identifier of this Canonical Record, unique within the record stream.

timestamp.description: Time the record was persisted (RFC 3339, UTC 'Z' suffix). Non-decreasing across the stream in sequence order; not earlier than observe.observed_at.

runtime_version.description: Version string of the runtime that produced the record.

contract.description: Runtime contract tag the record conforms to.

spec.description: Canonical spec release the contract derives from.
